integrity: The infinite theorem is proved from exact prefix-sum recurrences. The bundled finite verifier is a consistency replay and is not used as a substitute for the induction. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the ordinary paperfolding word under the stated 1-indexed odd-part convention. It establishes an explicit unbounded lower bound for the prefix-normal defect but does not claim exact maximal defect values or classify general paperfolding instruction sequences.
title: Unbounded prefix-normal defect of the ordinary paperfolding word
